clearing.name: Forest Clearing
clearing.description: A peaceful clearing where sunlight breaks through the canopy.
clearing.long_description: You find yourself in a small clearing surrounded by ancient trees. Sunlight filters through the leaves above, creating dancing patterns on the mossy ground. The air is fresh and filled with the sounds of birds and rustling leaves.

forest_path.name: Winding Forest Path
forest_path.description: A well-worn path winds through the dense forest.
forest_path.long_description: The path before you is narrow but clearly traveled. Trees press in from both sides, their branches creating a natural tunnel. You can see tracks in the dirt - both human and animal.

forest_inn.name: The Weary Traveler Inn
forest_inn.description: A cozy inn that serves as a haven for travelers.
forest_inn.long_description: Warm light spills from the windows of this sturdy wooden building. The sound of laughter and clinking mugs reaches your ears. A sign above the door depicts a sleeping traveler beneath a tree.

old_oak.name: The Ancient Oak
old_oak.description: An enormous oak tree that has stood for centuries.
old_oak.long_description: This tree is truly massive, its trunk wider than a house. Ancient runes are carved into its bark, glowing faintly with residual magic. The branches stretch impossibly high, and you can see a hollow entrance at its base.

tree_hollow.name: Hollow of the Ancient Oak
tree_hollow.description: The interior of the great oak, surprisingly spacious.
tree_hollow.long_description: Inside the oak, the space opens up into a natural chamber. Bioluminescent fungi provide soft light, revealing intricate patterns in the wood. The air hums with ancient magic.

stream.name: Babbling Stream
stream.description: A crystal-clear stream winds through the forest.
stream.long_description: Clear water flows over smooth stones, creating a peaceful melody. Small fish dart beneath the surface. The banks are covered in soft moss and ferns.

waterfall.name: Hidden Waterfall
waterfall.description: A majestic waterfall cascades into a crystal pool.
waterfall.long_description: Water crashes down from a cliff above, creating a permanent mist. A deep pool at the base reflects the sky like a mirror. Behind the waterfall, you spot what might be a cave entrance.

hidden_cave.name: Cave Behind the Waterfall
hidden_cave.description: A secret cave concealed by the waterfall.
hidden_cave.long_description: The cave is damp but surprisingly deep. Ancient markings cover the walls, and you can see the glint of something valuable in the darkness.

hunting_grounds.name: Hunter's Territory
hunting_grounds.description: An area where game animals are abundant.
hunting_grounds.long_description: Animal tracks crisscross the forest floor here. You can see signs of recent hunts - blood on leaves, scattered feathers. This is clearly hunting territory.

rangers_outpost.name: Ranger's Outpost
rangers_outpost.description: A fortified outpost overlooking the forest.
rangers_outpost.long_description: A sturdy wooden structure built high in the trees. From here, you can see for miles across the forest canopy. Weapons and supplies are stored neatly.

ancient_ruins.name: Forgotten Ruins
ancient_ruins.description: Crumbling stone structures from a lost civilization.
ancient_ruins.long_description: Moss-covered stones are all that remain of what was once a great structure. Strange symbols are carved into every surface. The air feels heavy with forgotten history.

underground_chamber.name: Ancient Chamber
underground_chamber.description: A vast underground chamber beneath the ruins.
underground_chamber.long_description: Columns of carved stone support a high ceiling. In the center stands an altar covered in strange runes. The walls depict scenes of ancient rituals and terrible beings.

old_tower.name: Watchtower Ruins
old_tower.description: An ancient stone tower slowly being reclaimed by the forest.
old_tower.long_description: The tower stands tall despite its age, ivy crawling up its walls. From the top, you'd have a commanding view of the forest. A spiral staircase winds upward.

wizard_tower.name: Arcane Tower
wizard_tower.description: A mysterious tower crackling with magical energy.
wizard_tower.long_description: The tower seems to shimmer with barely contained magic. Arcane symbols glow on its surface. The very air around it feels charged with power.

hermit_hut.name: Hermit's Hut
hermit_hut.description: A small, humble dwelling deep in the woods.
hermit_hut.long_description: A simple wooden hut surrounded by carefully tended herb gardens. Smoke rises from the chimney. Wind chimes made of bones hang from the eaves.

abandoned_forge.name: Old Forge
abandoned_forge.description: A once-busy forge, now mostly silent.
abandoned_forge.long_description: The forge fire still burns, never fully extinguished. Anvils and hammers sit ready for use. The walls are lined with weapons in various states of completion.

healing_grove.name: Healer's Grove
healing_grove.description: A peaceful grove filled with medicinal plants.
healing_grove.long_description: Flowers of every color bloom here, filling the air with sweet scents. The plants seem to glow with vitality. A small hut sits in the center.

thieves_den.name: Hidden Thieves' Den
thieves_den.description: A concealed hideout used by criminals.
thieves_den.long_description: The entrance is well-hidden behind a false rock. Inside, the den is surprisingly well-furnished with stolen goods. Maps and escape routes cover one wall.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: The heart of a small forest village.
village_square.long_description: A bustling square with a well at its center. Villagers go about their business. Buildings surround the square - shops, homes, a small chapel.

chapel_ruins.name: Ruined Chapel
chapel_ruins.description: An old chapel slowly being restored.
chapel_ruins.long_description: The chapel has seen better days, but someone is working to restore it. Fresh mortar fills cracks in the walls. Candles flicker on a makeshift altar.

graveyard.name: Old Graveyard
graveyard.description: A cemetery where the dead don't always rest peacefully.
graveyard.long_description: Weathered tombstones lean at odd angles. Some graves look recently disturbed. A cold mist clings to the ground even during the day.

witch_hut.name: Swamp Witch's Hut
witch_hut.description: A crooked hut in the middle of a dark swamp.
witch_hut.long_description: The hut stands on stilts above murky water. Strange symbols are painted on every surface. The smell of brewing potions fills the air.

old_mine.name: Abandoned Mine
old_mine.description: An old mining operation, mostly played out.
old_mine.long_description: Rusted equipment sits abandoned near the entrance. The tunnel descends into darkness. You can hear the drip of water and occasional cave-ins deep below.

crystal_cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
crystal_cavern.description: A cavern filled with glowing crystals.
crystal_cavern.long_description: Massive crystals jut from every surface, pulsing with inner light. The air hums with magical energy. This place feels ancient and powerful.

sacred_grove.name: Sacred Grove
sacred_grove.description: An ancient grove where druids once gathered.
sacred_grove.long_description: Massive trees form a perfect circle around a stone altar. The very air feels alive with nature's power. Animals watch you calmly from the shadows.

dark_forest.name: Dark Forest
dark_forest.description: A part of the woods where light barely penetrates.
dark_forest.long_description: The trees grow so thick here that even at noon, it feels like twilight. Strange sounds echo from the shadows. Every instinct tells you to turn back.

corrupted_glade.name: Corrupted Glade
corrupted_glade.description: A once-beautiful glade now twisted by dark magic.
corrupted_glade.long_description: Dead trees reach toward a sickly sky. The ground is cracked and oozing black ichor. Corrupted creatures prowl the edges.

heart_of_darkness.name: The Heart of Darkness
heart_of_darkness.description: The source of corruption, where ancient evil dwells.
heart_of_darkness.long_description: Reality itself seems to warp here. Shadows move with malevolent purpose. At the center, an altar pulses with terrible power. This is where it all began.
